criteria.statement: A fake-client test shows a manifest with a missing, unapproved, or hash-mismatched case refuses the run and names that case
A test shows `--repeat 3` produces three independent records per case keyed by case, model, cap, arm and repeat index
A test shows the identity record contains every field listed in brief section 4.2, including the commit run from
A test shows a dirty checkout and a commit different from `--expect-commit` each refuse the run before any call
A test shows an experiment run writes only under its own run folder and leaves `apps/backend/src/eval/answer-quality/results.json` byte-identical; a routine run still merges as before
A test shows a regrade run makes zero answer calls, never writes into the source run folder, and records the source run id and manifest hash
`npm run eval:answer-quality` with no key and no experiment flags still dry-runs without a network call
